title: Households
summary: Household survey: one row per household with the head's name, ward, number of members, monthly income, savings and debts (rupees), a 1-10 vulnerability score and its location (lat/lon).

household_head.meaning: name of the head of the household
household_head.label: Household head

ward.meaning: ward the household is in (no fixed list)
ward.label: Ward

members.meaning: number of people in the household
members.label: Members

debts_inr.meaning: household's total outstanding debt in rupees
debts_inr.label: Debts (Rs)

validations.message: members is not a number between 1 and 30
monthly income is not a number
vulnerability score is not between 1 and 10

questions.ask: Which ward has the highest total debt, savings or monthly income: every ward ranked by the total, with household count and average per household

measure.description: what to add up: debt, savings or income (default debt)

questions.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT ward, CASE lower(trim({{measure}})) WHEN 'debt' THEN debts_inr WHEN 'debts' THEN debts_inr WHEN 'savings' THEN savings_inr WHEN 'saving' THEN savings_inr WHEN 'income' THEN monthly_income_inr WHEN 'monthly income' THEN monthly_income_inr ELSE error('measure must be debt, savings or income') END AS v FROM {{table}}) SELECT ward, count(*) AS households, sum(v) AS total_inr, round(avg(v), 0) AS average_per_household_inr, count(*) - count(v) AS households_missing_value FROM m GROUP BY ward ORDER BY total_inr DESC NULLS LAST, ward

history.taught: rank wards by total debt, savings or monthly income
form fields: labels, measures, business rules (DGX migration to the form format)
